One list of instances instead of two, a switch for rainbow mode, and a light theme that is yellow again.

## ⚡ Improved

- **One way to the instances, not two.** The Downloads screen carried an "Instances" link and a "Switch" link side by side, both leading to a list. "Switch" is now called "Overview" — which is what that screen is, since every member of the group is a connection on it — and the second link is gone. So is the screen it led to: it listed the peers a connected instance knows about, and it was also the last place in the app that still took an instance by name and address, which the connection phrase replaced everywhere else.
- **Rainbow mode has a switch.** It was a line that said where the mode was set rather than a control that set it. Only on and off are decided in the app; the palette and the seed still come from the instance, so two clients of one server never disagree about which colour a position is.
- **The switches follow the corner setting.** They were drawn as fixed pills whatever the shape was set to, so on Square every other control squared off and the switches stayed round.
- **The light theme's accent is a yellow again.** It used to swap the whole accent for a dark yellow, which painted every badge, switch and filled button olive-brown. One token was doing two jobs: a colour on a fill needs no darkening, a colour used as text on a near-white page does. The accent is now the accent, and the darkening applies where the colour is ink — and it applies to a colour you picked as well as to the default, which the old fixed constant never did.
- **The overview shows the app's mark beside its name**, and a connection is dropped with a square bin badge rather than the word "Remove". The badges are square, one size, and carry no drawn border — the same shape the web interface and the browser extension use.

## 📋 Notes

- Eleven strings belonging to the removed screen left all 42 languages. "Overview" was taken from the web interface's own translation of the same word rather than translated a second time.
